title: Anthropic closes below its IPO price, and Tidal sets a date to remove fully AI-generated recordings
description: Less than a week after its stock market debut, Anthropic ended Tuesday below its $83 offer price. Tidal set a deadline for fully AI-generated recordings. Two amateur astronomers used AI to find signals worth a second look, and ShellBench tested how well assistants could make sense of a deskful of old bills.

anthropic-below-ipo.verification_scope: The AP market close report, the issuer’s offering announcement and TechCrunch’s midday report establish the closing position, offer price and intraday quote.

planet-candidates.verification_scope: OpenAI describes the two independent searches, recovery of known signals and candidates still awaiting confirmation.

tidal-recording-policy.verification_scope: Tidal’s support page sets out the effective date, royalty policy and appeals process. Its account to TechCrunch gives the denominator for recent submissions.

shellbench-everyday.verification_scope: The team’s announcement gives the method, full-task completion rate and evidence-tracing criteria. The full paper was pending.

pinterest-teen-controls.verification_scope: The product announcement and the following day’s reporting cover recommendation controls, alerts, autoplay and the parental passcode.

ifood-agent-results.verification_scope: The customer account describes background execution and how results are accepted. The figures come from iFood.

intent-cocreation.verification_scope: Table 1, the classification of commitment and the discussion in version 1 analyze system descriptions in 198 papers. The authors did not run a comparative user trial.
intent-cocreation.date_note: Version 1 submitted November 23 and listed by arXiv on November 24

noam-brown-poker.verification_scope: Sequoia Capital’s show notes, the chapter headings at 04:37, 09:39 and 14:59, and the Concourse entry. The account paraphrases the publisher.

llamacpp-cache-restore.verification_scope: Maintainers’ b12675 release notes, merged pull request #32828 and the MIT license. The software was not run or benchmarked.
